scope: Bounded source-only compatibility review of lifecycle #1693 and owned binary artwork #1695; no combined release, branch mutation, app execution or functional tests.

findings.detail: The sole shared path is game/app.mjs. Artwork changes only its import, route-host serializeArtwork option, and candidate-picture acquire injection. Lifecycle changes only pending action/pickup retirement in the fixed-step loop. Exact common-base diff ranges do not overlap.

Artwork attempt.mjs 149–167 still loads verified bytes and awaits full owned decode with cancellation/current checks before candidate transfer. Its take() 223–231 transfers the picture once. App preparation/adoption paths retain generation, focus/visibility and owner checks; cancelled or abandoned tickets release the picture.

App accepted activation at artwork lines10924–10949 clears preparation/recovery, calls clearInput() (including scene-clock reset), then marks neutralResumeTick and sets playing. These source excerpts are byte-identical in base, artwork and lifecycle heads. Async image preparation time cannot enter play through either changed hunk.

Lifecycle preserves only fresh pending action/pickup behind the accepted neutral tick and explicitly clears them on respawn/capture stop. No image-owner or preparation callback reads/writes those flags; artwork does not change the fixed-step loop, clock, input polling or interruption threshold.

The binary picture URL remains owned through decode and rendering, and release clears/closes the owned image before revoking the URL. It is not added to checkpoints/replays. The lifecycle hunk neither changes picture adoption nor releases this owner.

Artwork solo-dom fixture changes only Blob URL registry routing and teardown. Lifecycle cadence/input controls use ordinary campaign plus optional readPads/touch setup; they do not inject an audio URL registry or custom candidate loader. No frame/timing/input fixture conflict found.

conclusion: No concrete ordering, scene-clock or image-ownership conflict found in this bounded source review. Preserve both reviewed implementations when integrating.
limits: No combined app was executed and no regression/performance pass is inferred.
Actual combined-head source, strict replay, production package and native-browser qualification remain required.
Other PRs and whole-app behavior are outside this bounded joint-hunk review.
